resources.string:
Clipbird cannot start because the temporary directory (%1$s) is mounted with the noexec option. This prevents Java from loading native libraries extracted into that directory.

How to fix it:

Configure Java to use a temporary directory that allows file execution.

Add the following line to ~/.profile:

export JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS="-Djava.io.tmpdir=$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR"

After updating the configuration, log out and log back in, then start Clipbird again.
